settings.triggersOnEditDesc: Automatically check and move the edited note when a file is modified
settings.triggersPeriodicDesc: Enable the periodic movement of notes
settings.triggersIntervalDesc: Set the interval for the periodic movement of notes in minutes
settings.triggersIntervalInvalid: Enter a whole number of minutes from 1 to 1440
settings.filterSectionDesc: Blacklist filters: files that match any criterion are excluded from move operations.
settings.filterSearchDesc: Files that match any criterion are excluded from move operations.
settings.filterEmpty: No filters are configured. Add one using the control below to exclude files from move operations.
settings.rulesIntroLead: The Advanced Note Mover will move files to the folder associated with the specified criteria.
settings.rulesIntroTail: Criteria can be tags, filenames, paths, content, properties, or dates. If multiple rules match, the first one will be applied.
settings.rulesCreateFoldersDesc: When enabled (default), destination folders are created automatically if they do not exist. When disabled, notes are skipped and not moved if the destination folder is missing. Individual rules can override this in the rule editor.
settings.rulesReEvaluateDesc: After changing rules, preview which files would move to their new destinations before applying any moves.
settings.rulesEmpty: No rules are configured. Add one using the control below.
settings.attachmentsMoveDesc: When a markdown note is moved, also move images and other attachments referenced in the note that live in the note folder or its subfolders (e.g. _assets/). Relative link structure is preserved.
settings.attachmentsSkipDesc: Do not move attachment files that are also linked from other notes. Prevents breaking references elsewhere in the vault.
settings.attachmentsDeleteEmptyDesc: After moving attachments, remove source folders (such as _assets) that no longer contain any files.
settings.conflictOverwriteWarning: Warning: always overwrite will replace existing files at the destination without confirmation. You may lose data.
settings.conflictAutoWarning: Warning: conflicts will be handled automatically without asking. You can change this setting at any time.
settings.historyClearDesc: Clears the history of moved notes
settings.historyClearMessage:
Are you sure you want to clear the history?

This action cannot be undone.
settings.historyRetentionDesc: Configure how long history entries should be kept
settings.importExportExportDesc: Export your current settings as a JSON file
settings.importExportImportDesc: Import settings from a JSON file
settings.importExportImportMessage:
This will replace your current settings with the imported ones.

This action cannot be undone. Make sure you have a backup of your current settings.
settings.performanceCacheLead: Cache rule evaluation results so unchanged files are not re-evaluated on every periodic or on-edit run.
settings.performanceCacheTail: This significantly improves performance for vaults with many files and rules.
settings.performanceVaultCacheDesc: Caches movable file lists (notes, canvases, bases) and derived tag/property indices from markdown. Turn off to always scan the vault (useful for debugging stale suggestions).
settings.performanceDebugDesc: Logs timing spans to the developer console as [Advanced Note Mover perf] and records them for export. Disable when not profiling.
settings.performanceExportReady: Downloads recorded timings as JSON for before/after comparison.
settings.performanceExportOff: Turn on performance debug logs first to record timings.
settings.updatesReleaseNotesName: Show release notes after plugin update
settings.updatesReleaseNotesDesc: When enabled, opens the changelog modal once after you install a newer plugin version. Applies across all vaults; does not show on every startup or vault switch.

modals.confirmDeleteRule:
Are you sure you want to delete the rule {rule}?

This action cannot be undone.
modals.historyEmpty: No history entries for the selected time range.
modals.updateTitle: Advanced Note Mover updated to version {version}!
modals.ruleEditorDestinationShort: Folder path or template. Type {{ for suggestions.
modals.ruleEditorDestinationDescription: Folder or template where files matching this rule will be moved. Supports {{tag.*}}, {{property.*}}, and {{file.*}} placeholders. Use frontmatter dates via Archive/{{property.created.year}} or formats such as Journal/{{property.created.YYYY-MM-DD}}; use filesystem times via Inbox/{{file.created.DD-MM-YYYY}} or {{file.modified.year}}. Type {{tag., {{property., or {{file. to get template suggestions.
modals.ruleEditorActiveOn: This rule is applied when notes are moved.
modals.ruleEditorCreateFolderDesc: Control whether a missing destination folder is created for this rule.
modals.ruleEditorDiscardMessage: You have unsaved changes. Discard them?
modals.ruleEditorConditionRequired: At least one condition is required.
modals.conflictExists: A file named {fileName} already exists at the destination.
modals.conflictChoose: Choose how to handle this conflict
modals.conflictAlwaysDesc: Apply the selected strategy automatically for future conflicts without asking.
modals.conflictAlwaysWarning: Warning: future conflicts will be handled automatically without asking. Choosing overwrite will replace existing files at the destination.
modals.conflictSkipTooltip: Leave the note in its current location and remember this conflict
modals.conflictRenameTooltip: Move the note with a numeric suffix, for example note (1).md
modals.conflictOverwriteTooltip: Replace the existing file at the destination. Existing content will be lost.
modals.conflictCacheIntro: Notes that were skipped because a file already exists at the destination.
modals.conflictCacheRetryTooltip: Remove from cache and try moving again
modals.conflictCacheRemoveStaleTooltip: Remove entries whose source or target no longer exists
modals.conflictCacheClearMessage: Remove all skipped move conflict entries? Automatic triggers will try to move these notes again.

conflictStrategyDescriptions.ask: Show a dialog when a file with the same name already exists at the destination.
conflictStrategyDescriptions.skip: Leave the note in its current location and notify you when a conflict occurs.
conflictStrategyDescriptions.rename: Automatically append a numeric suffix (e.g. note (1).md) to avoid overwriting.
conflictStrategyDescriptions.overwrite: Replace the existing file at the destination without asking. Existing content will be lost.

ruleEditorAggregation.any: At least one condition must match.
